classification.resume: The record is a Swiss Federal Archives file documenting Swiss involvement in two international initiatives of the 1920s: the creation of an International Commission for Historic Monuments and an international convention for the legal protection of artistic heritage. It contains administrative correspondence and publications related to these topics within the framework of Swiss foreign policy and intellectual cooperation.
